SCD_Start_Date	date

isActive	int
isLatest	int
BNK_Code	varchar(5)
Source_Code	varchar(20)
File_name	varchar(100)

CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_D30_CUSTOMER]
(
	[H] [varchar](25) NULL,
	[USERNAME]	varchar(50),
	[FULL_NAME]	varchar(100),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(50),
	[ENROLLMENT_DATE]	datetime,
	[Device]	varchar(255),
	[Device_OS]	varchar(50),
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100) NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2] NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_D30_CUSTOMER_SELECT_SRC]
( 
	[USERNAME]	varchar(50),
	[FULL_NAME]	varchar(100),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(50),
	[ENROLLMENT_DATE]	datetime,
	[Device]	varchar(255),
	[Device_OS]	varchar(50),
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG] [int]  NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [d360].[STG_EDS_D30_CUSTOMER_GROUP_SRC]
( 
	[USERNAME]	varchar(50),
	[FULL_NAME]	varchar(100),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(50),
	[ENROLLMENT_DATE]	datetime,
	[Device]	varchar(255),
	[Device_OS]	varchar(50),
	[FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100)  NULL,
	[JSRC_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[JTAR_FLG_CNT] [int]  NULL,
	[FILE_DATE] [date]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
	HEAP
);
GO


CREATE TABLE [EDS].[D30_CUSTOMER]
( 
	[USERNAME]	varchar(50),
	[FULL_NAME]	varchar(100),
	[CIF_ID]	varchar(50),
	[ENROLLMENT_DATE]	datetime,
	[Device]	varchar(255),
	[Device_OS]	varchar(50),
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [char](1)  NULL,
	[isLatest] [char](1)  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([CIF_ID]),
	HEAP
);
GO
